findings.observation: python -m scripts.docs verify --skip-build exits 1: functions 88.7% < 90% threshold (missing=795). tests.yml proof-or-stop producer captures rc then exit 0.
findings.method: python -m scripts.docs verify --skip-build; read .github/workflows/tests.yml docs_runtime step; read verify.py
findings.expected: Canonical verify chain is fail-closed when docstring coverage is below THRESHOLDS.
findings.actual: Local verify fails at check-docstrings. tests.yml always exits 0 after capturing the log. Raising the 90% cap is forbidden.
findings.impact: Documented one-command verify is red locally; tests.yml does not fail the producer job on that red.
findings.root_cause: Function docstring coverage below frozen 90% gate; producer swallows rc.
findings.remediation: Do not raise THRESHOLDS. Pay down missing public function docstrings in src/bioetl, or isolate check-docstrings from docs.yml if product policy changes. Out of docs-content edit scope.
